credit_monitor.name: Credit Monitor Agent
credit_monitor.description: Analyzes credit balances across all connected Lyzr accounts, generates status summaries, identifies low-balance accounts, and creates alert notifications.

usage_analytics.name: Usage Analytics Agent
usage_analytics.description: Analyzes historical credit consumption patterns, identifies usage trends, compares account-level utilization rates, and generates optimization insights.

account_advisor.name: Account Advisor Agent
account_advisor.description: Reviews account configurations and credit distribution, recommends rebalancing strategies, and suggests consolidation opportunities across accounts.
